description: Capabilities for the main and popup windows: both listen for the Rust-emitted "snapshot" event and call get_snapshot once on load (02_design.md §7.3); only "main" starts a window drag from the data-tauri-drag-region header (§7.2), and only "main" resizes itself to fit its collapsed/expanded content (app.js) — the popup has neither, but sharing the permissions is harmless since it never calls them.
